title: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 1.8.20. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'vbf<field_id>' parameter, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access affected pages.
